title: DeHate: A Stable Diffusion-based Multimodal Approach to Mitigate Hate Speech in Images
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to the 'dehatification' of images, which it explicitly defines as a core challenge for the 'ethical integrity' and 'trustworthiness' of AI models.
